name: SH2 Cast - Left Staff (aimed)
description: MSCO's Base - Left Staff art on the neutral MSCO_left1-4 path names, for a fire-and-forget AIMED cast resolved to the LEFT hand while a staff is held in that hand. IsEquippedType 8 is kStaff and the hand boolean is the PHYSICAL hand, exactly MSCO's own vocabulary at its 6800 submod. Sits above cast_left so the staff art wins whenever the staff is there; MSCO's own precedence puts Self (6901) above Staff (6800), so the self cells deliberately stay self art. The clips keep MSCO's MLh_SpellFire_Event (0.400000 / 0.333333 / 0.400000 / 0.366667) and carry no root motion.
